messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #17560 needs to land before the Thurs maintenance blackout (2026-03-20 02:00 UTC). CI queue is ~3h and the mac matrix is flaking. Can we coordinate a pre-freeze merge slot? :eyes:

maya: Which jobs are failing? can we rerun just the flaky shards?

alex: Mostly mac-11/x86 unit tests timing out (TestKVEviction). Saw sporadic timeouts in the logs. Example snippet:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVEviction (0.42s)
    eviction_test.go:88: expected key evicted within 50ms, got 200ms
```

ci-bot: Build queued for PR #17560. Position in queue: 18. Estimated wait ~3h (based on current throughput).

ryan: I can reserve a pre-freeze merge slot at ~2026-03-19 20:00 UTC if you rebase now. We'll need a green canary run + sarah signoff for rollout.

alex: Rebased and force-pushed: `git pull --rebase origin main && git push --force-with-lease`. Triggered a new CI run for the updated head.

devops: Reminder: maintenance blackout 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC — no deploys during that window. If we miss the slot, we'll have to wait until after the blackout. :warning:

sarah: I can take the canary and run smoke tests at 2026-03-19 21:00 UTC. Please ping me when CI is green and I'll kick off verification. :+1:

maya: Left a tiny comment about adjusting the KV eviction timeout in the test harness — non-blocking. Approving after it's addressed. :thumbsup:

alex: Addressed the test harness timeout and force-pushed a fix. Thanks for catching that.

ci-bot: All required checks passed for PR #17560 — mergeable.

ryan: Slot reserved. Landing at 2026-03-19 21:45 UTC to avoid the blackout window. Good job coordinating everyone. :tada:

alex: Landed and monitoring post-merge. Will report any regressions. :sparkles:

sarah: Smoke ok, no rollout anomalies observed.

alex: Closing the loop — reopen if anything flakey shows up. Thanks all. :eyes:
